Site.DevicesText: Connect supported YOKONEX and DG-LAB devices using Bluetooth, WebSocket GATT, high-level control or remote events.
Site.GraphAlt: A waveform connected to Bluetooth and WebSocket channel outputs. Illustrative diagram.
Site.Headline: Cross-platform device control
Site.Intro: Combine waveforms, audio, touch and sensor input in node pipelines to control local and remote devices.
Site.LoadError: Could not load page resources. Refresh the page to try again.
Site.ModulesIntro: Open a module directly. Device output is optional and connects to your running YokoWave app.
Site.PipelinesText: Connect typed ports, adjust each output node and save reusable templates. Each instance runs independently.
Site.Setup1: In YokoWave, connect your device and start a WebSocket Control server pipeline with its output routing and limits configured.
Site.Setup2: Open a browser module and enter the server endpoint and token. For remote connections from this HTTPS site, use a browser-trusted wss:// endpoint.
Site.Setup3: Choose a device and channel, set strength, then enable output manually. The desktop app applies its own output limits.
Site.SetupIntro: Play without a device, or connect to your desktop app. This static site does not host a device-control server.
Site.WaveformsText: Use built-in or custom waveforms, create playlists, and map audio, touch or sensor input to numeric signals.
